headline: Civil Service Commission

meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission met July 1, 2026, in person and online.
meeting.recap: The Civil Service Commission met July 1, 2026, in person and online.[[0:00:36]] Presentations planned for this meeting were put off because one commissioner was absent.[[0:09:09]] Staff hope to open the job posting for a new Director of Personnel Services tomorrow.[[0:09:40]] The posting is set to close July 31.[[0:10:54]] An arbitration award (a ruling by a neutral decision-maker) for bargaining unit 15 is still pending.[[0:12:37]] Most county employees get an across-the-board raise starting today, the director said.[[0:13:17]] The department's new consultant plans to present its work to county leaders July 13.[[0:15:34]] The department's fiscal year 2027 budget was approved at a little over $3.2 million.[[0:25:21]] The budget adds an investigator and a public information officer.[[0:25:28]] The salary commission met June 12 and gave no raises to elected officials, directors or deputies.[[0:28:24]] The county has 962 open positions.[[0:30:17]] Departments have sent only 335 requests to fill vacant positions.[[0:31:49]] The director said this was a final monthly report before leaving July 31.[[0:44:18]] The next meeting is set for August 5, 2026, at 9 a.m.[[0:45:18]]
decided: Presentations planned for this meeting were put off because one commissioner was absent.
The commission voted to adjourn the meeting.
meeting.next: Staff hope to open the job posting for the new director tomorrow. Staff are working on a press release to announce the director's retirement. The commission's legal counsel will report back on whether commissioners working with the consultant can give a summary after each meeting. The director agreed to give the commission a breakdown of the open positions.
